name: SAB
recent: SAB 于 2026 年 11 月 13 日公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度的合并业绩，并持续按月披露种植 / 木材生产数据。公司在 2026 年 8 月 28 日举行第 45 届常年股东大会，所有决议均获通过，包括派发每股 5 仙的单层终期股息。此外，公司近期出现首席官员及董事会成员变动。
notable: 第 45 届常年股东大会于 2026 年 8 月 28 日举行，所有决议均获股东通过。
股东批准派发截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日止财政年度每股 5 仙的单层终期股息。
公司出现首席官员及董事会成员变动，包括 Dato' Sri Dr Low Kok Thye 和 Tan Sri Datuk Seri Panglima Sulong bin Matjeraie 的董事会变动。

recent_en: SAB announced its consolidated results for the quarter ended 30 September 2026 on 13 November 2026, and continued to disclose monthly production figures for mining/plantation/timber. The company held its 45th AGM on 28 August 2026, where all resolutions were passed, including a single-tier final dividend of 5 sen per share. There were also changes in principal officer and boardroom members recently.
notable_en: The 45th AGM was held on 28 August 2026 and all resolutions were passed by shareholders.
Shareholders approved a single-tier final dividend of 5 sen per share for the financial year ended 31 March 2026.
There were changes in principal officer and boardroom members, including boardroom changes for Dato' Sri Dr Low Kok Thye and Tan Sri Datuk Seri Panglima Sulong bin Matjeraie.
